activity_summary: At Holy Trinity the vicar preached the fire as judgment on a town that malts on the Sabbath. He said the hand had come down twice in fourteen months. You told the pew to let it come whole. You did not improve it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard it, and refused to mend it there.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Told Susanna to sit, and kept the pew still.

entities.name: Mary Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the barley was still the town's work.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard fourteen as a count, and kept the three heads.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Saw Judith storing the voice for dinner.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat in the pew and kept the voice.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Saw the count made on the fingers.

facets.activity: Heard the fire preached as judgment

quotes.speaker: susanna_shakespeare
quotes.text: He said fourteen. He said it as a count

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Let it come whole. I will not mend it in the pew

quotes.speaker: mary_shakespeare
quotes.text: The barley is still the town's work, whatever he makes of the day it is done
